definitions.explanation: Something given as a reward for good behavior, effort, or achievement. The ご prefix adds politeness or warmth. Commonly used with children but also for self-indulgence (treating oneself).

examples.japanese: ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a cake as a reward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I worked hard, so I bought myself a bag as a treat.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧な⟦おもちゃ→おもちゃ：01334_omocha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{選|えら}ばせて→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: My child got good grades, so as a reward I let them pick a toy they liked.

notes:
The honorific prefix ご is attached to ⟦{褒美|ほうび}→褒美：10478_houbi⟧ (reward). While ⟦{褒美|ほうび}→褒美：10478_houbi⟧ on its own sounds somewhat stiff or old-fashioned, ご{褒美|ほうび} is the standard form in modern Japanese and feels warm and friendly.

USAGE:
Very commonly used in the phrase ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{褒美|ほうび} (a treat for oneself), which has become a popular concept in Japanese consumer culture — the idea of rewarding yourself with a purchase or experience after working hard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦あげる→あげる：00546_ageru⟧: to give a reward
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a reward
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{褒美|ほうび}: a treat for oneself
- ご{褒美|ほうび}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a reward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: remuneration, compensation — formal, used for payment for work or services
- ⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧: prize, award — given for winning competitions or achieving excellence
- ご{褒美|ほうび} vs ⟦{罰|ばつ}→罰：10154_batsu⟧: reward vs punishment — the classic pair in child-rearing and motivation
